turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue for September 2026 (1 to 30 September) was EUR 12,582.75, computed by the Net revenue (EUR) metric, which is revenue minus partner returns, with returns counted on their return date rather than the order date. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
